gloss: for a long time; for many years

definitions.gloss: for a long time; for a long while; for many years
definitions.explanation: An adverb indicating that something has continued for a long period. Slightly formal and polite in tone, often used when acknowledging someone's patience or long-standing relationship.

examples.japanese: {長|なが}らく⟦お{待|ま}たせ→お待たせ：27262_omatase⟧⟦しました→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Thank you for waiting so long. (Sorry to have kept you waiting.)

examples.japanese: {長|なが}らくご{愛顧|あいこ}⟦いただき→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧、⟦ありがとうございます→ありがとうございます：09886_arigatougozaimasu⟧。
examples.english: Thank you for your long patronage.

examples.japanese: {長|なが}らく⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧まいりました⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{今月|こんげつ}{末|まつ}→今月末：28384_kongetsumatsu⟧⟦をもちまして→をもちまして：22962_womochimashite⟧⟦{閉店|へいてん}→閉店：09698_heiten⟧⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: We have been in business for a long time, but we will be closing at the end of this month.

notes:
USAGE:
{長|なが}らく is a formal, polite adverb often used in set phrases expressing gratitude or apology for something that has lasted a long time. It is very common in customer service, business, and ceremonial language.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {長|なが}らく⟦お{待|ま}たせ→お待たせ：27262_omatase⟧⟦しました→する：00392_suru⟧ (sorry to have kept you waiting)
- {長|なが}らくご{愛顧|あいこ}⟦いただき→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧ (thank you for your long patronage)
- {長|なが}らく⟦お{世話|せわ}→お世話：02506_osewa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりました→なる：01970_naru⟧ (thank you for your support over the years)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {長|なが}らく: for a long time (formal, polite)
- ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧: for a long time (neutral, everyday)
- ⟦ずっと→ずっと：00912_zutto⟧: all along, the whole time (casual, emphasizes continuity)
